pr_body:
Closes #1961 

Implements the customization flags for swaylock that were in the man page and their variants for all possible states, with the requested dashes mixed in.

I also implemented `i3lock`'s `-e, --ignore-empty-password`, which prevents empty passwords from being validated _(obviously this flag should not be given if for whatever reason the user's password is empty)_. 

Additionally, since the list of flags has grown to be relatively large, I changed the order of them to make it easier to locate them in the code/usage/man page.

issue_context.title: Implement swaylock visual customization flags
issue_context.body: See the man page. Let's sprinkle some dashes in, too, like `--textcolor` -> `--text-color`.
